name: krizaka-java-site
description: java.krizaka.com — the documentation of Krizaka Java, a static site built from the code of the repositories it documents.

scripts.gen: node scripts/gen-building-blocks.mjs && node scripts/gen-configuration.mjs && node scripts/gen-registry-versions.mjs && node scripts/gen-proof.mjs
scripts.build: npm run gen && next build && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit && krizaka-i18n check messages && node scripts/gen-building-blocks.mjs --check && node scripts/gen-configuration.mjs --check && node scripts/check-features.mjs && node scripts/check-content.mjs
